**About The Role**
 We’re building a next\-generation ambient AI platform for healthcare, helping clinicians focus on patient care by automatically capturing, understanding, and structuring clinical conversations in real time.
   

  

 Our product supports clinicians across the full care workflow, from capturing patient conversations and reviewing AI\-generated documentation to coordinating follow\-up actions and completing work across mobile and web.
   

  

 We’re hiring a Full\-Stack Product Engineer to build these experiences from end to end. You’ll work across our mobile and web applications, backend services, APIs, and AI\-powered workflows, partnering closely with product, design, clinical, and AI teams.
   

  

 This role is for an engineer who cares deeply about the people using the product. You think beyond whether a feature technically works to whether it is intuitive, responsive, trustworthy, and valuable in a real clinical environment. You’re comfortable moving through the stack to solve the whole problem, whether that means refining an interaction, designing an API, improving a data model, integrating an AI capability, or strengthening the system behind the experience.
   

  

 Our mobile application is primarily built in Flutter, alongside web applications, browser\-based surfaces, and backend services. Flutter experience is helpful but not required. We value strong product engineering judgment, full\-stack versatility, and a track record of shipping high\-quality user experiences.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Build and own high\-impact product experiences from early exploration through launch, measurement, and iteration.
* Develop new workflows for AI\-native healthcare software, including:
+ Real\-time transcription and ambient documentation
+ AI\-assisted review, editing, and clinical workflows
+ Multimodal inputs and intelligent recommendations
+ Agentic actions that help clinicians complete work
+ Collaborative and cross\-device workflows
+ Offline and low\-connectivity experiences

* Work across mobile, web, backend services, and APIs to deliver cohesive end\-to\-end experiences.
* Partner closely with clinicians, product managers, and designers to understand real\-world problems and translate them into simple, thoughtful products.
* Collaborate with AI engineers to bring model capabilities into production in ways that are responsive, understandable, and trustworthy.
* Design data models, APIs, and service boundaries that support fast product iteration and reliable user experiences.
* Build polished interfaces across our Flutter mobile application and web\-based surfaces.

* Improve shared systems and product foundations when they unlock faster or better development, including:
+ Reusable application components and interaction patterns
+ State management and data\-fetching primitives
+ Networking, caching, and synchronization
+ Background processing and resilient workflows
+ APIs, services, and asynchronous jobs
+ Logging, monitoring, and product diagnostics

* Prototype quickly, learn from real usage, and refine experiences using qualitative and quantitative feedback.
* Help shape product and technical strategy as the Ambient AI product line grows.
* Mentor other engineers and raise the bar for engineering quality, product thinking, and craft across the team.
